name: Chicken Pizza
description: Homemade chicken pizza with a soft crust, seasoned chicken, vegetables, pizza sauce and melted cheese.
ingredients: 250 g boneless chicken, cooked and seasoned
method: Mix flour, yeast, sugar, salt, warm water and a little oil to make a soft dough.
Cover the dough and let it rise until nearly doubled.
Roll the dough and place it on a pizza tray.
Spread pizza sauce and add chicken, capsicum and onion.
Top generously with mozzarella and oregano.
Bake in a preheated oven at 220°C until the crust is golden and cheese is bubbling.
